evidence.quote: Later that afternoon they heard yelling.
"It sounds like some people are in trouble," said the Tang Monk.
"You all wait here," said Wukong.
"I'll go and investigate."
The monkey leaped into the air and looked around.
He saw a group of Buddhist monks pushing a cart up a steep hill.

answers.rationale: 众人先听见喊叫，悟空因此主动去调查，飞到空中后才看见推车的和尚；原文没有任何气味触发调查，所以 B、C 都不是原因。

evidence.quote: He saw a group of Buddhist monks pushing a cart up a steep hill.
The cart was loaded with big stones.
The monks looked miserable.
Two Daoist priests stood nearby.
"Work faster!" yelled one of the priests.
They struggled to move the cart faster.

answers.rationale: 佛教和尚正把装满大石头的车推上陡坡；发号施令的是道士，和尚没有对道士叫喊，也没有逃跑。

evidence.quote: "The Daoists won't treat us this way forever," said a third monk.
"The spirit of the planet Venus visited us in a dream one night. He said that one day someone would come along to save us."
"Who is going to save you?"
"A fierce monkey spirit," said the monk.
"His name is Sun Wukong. He is so powerful that Heaven's entire army couldn't defeat him!"

answers.rationale: 和尚转述太白金星预言，一位名叫孙悟空的凶猛猴精会来救他们；悟净和八戒均未被预言点名。

evidence.quote: The Tiger Immortal puffed out his chest.
"I can summon rain," he said.
"Well then, let's have a contest," said the Tiger Immortal.
"Whoever summons more rain is the winner. If you win, I'll let you and all the monks go free. But if I win, you must stay here and be my slaves."
"You're a fool," said Wukong.
"I accept your challenge."

answers.rationale: 虎力大仙提出比谁召雨更多，悟空明确说接受挑战，所以 A 成立；唐僧担心悟空输掉，未认为他必胜；虎力大仙祈求的是雨，不是风。

evidence.quote: The next morning Wukong woke up early.
Someone was pounding on the door of the building.
A voice boomed, "I am the Tiger Immortal!"
The Tang Monk's eyes popped open.

answers.rationale: 清晨有人砸门并高喊自己是虎力大仙，门内的唐僧等人才被惊醒；砸门者不是唐僧或龙王。

evidence.quote: Wukong looked up at the sky, which was becoming dark.
Wind blew and dark clouds moved in. Thunder rumbled.
Wukong chuckled. "You all wait here. I'll be right back."
The monkey recited a quick spell and then left his body.
Up in the sky, he found the Old Woman of the Wind fanning the clouds.
The Dragon King of the Eastern Sea was approaching.

answers.rationale: 悟空离开肉身后直接到天空寻找操纵风云和降雨的神灵；他不是去休息，也没有去找武器。

evidence.quote: As the Tang Monk stared at the box, Wukong plucked a hair.
Using his magic, he made the hair look like himself.
Then he made himself tiny and squeezed through a crack in the box.
Inside the box was a ripe peach.
Quickly he ate the peach, leaving only the pit.
Wukong leaned toward the monk and whispered, "It's a peach pit."

answers.rationale: 悟空缩小进入盒子，吃完整颗桃，只留下桃核，并把答案告诉唐僧；盒中没有留下完整桃子或金箍棒。

evidence.quote: "I challenge you to a meditation contest," said the Tiger Immortal.
"Whoever can meditate the longest without moving is the winner."
"This won't be an ordinary meditation contest. We will float in the air and meditate. Can you do that?"
They sat down with their legs crossed and their palms facing up.
Wukong brushed the flea away and scratched the Tang Monk's head.

answers.rationale: 虎力大仙定义的比赛是悬空打坐，正式内容包括冥想和漂浮；抓痒是悟空后来为唐僧排除跳蚤的辅助动作，不是比赛项目，因此 A 是否定题答案。

evidence.quote: After a moment the Tiger Immortal slowly floated up into the air.
"Uh-oh," said Bajie. "Master can't do that. He'll lose the contest."
"Don't worry," said Wukong.
"He just needs some help from me."
The monkey recited a spell and then blew toward the Tang Monk.
The monk lifted off the ground.
Soon he was floating next to the Tiger Immortal.

answers.rationale: 唐僧无法自行悬空，悟空念咒吹气使他升起并漂浮；唐僧本就擅长冥想，悟空也帮助他赢而不是输。

evidence.quote: "How will we cross this river?" said the Tang Monk.
"It's so wide, I can't see the other side."

"It's just that life is very bad in this village. A few years ago, a terrible demon arrived. He's always treated us badly, but now things are worse. He demanded that we give him a child. If we don't, he'll destroy our entire village. Tomorrow morning I must . . . hand over my son!"
Wukong giggled and then laughed.
"I'm not laughing at you, sir. I'm laughing because today is the luckiest day of your life."
"But I am Sun Wukong, the Monkey King. I once defeated the Jade Emperor's entire army. And tomorrow I will save your son's life."

answers.rationale: 大河宽得看不到对岸，陈也确实被迫次日交出儿子；悟空听后反而发笑并自信承诺救孩子，未表现出害怕妖怪，所以 A 是不正确项。

evidence.quote: The street was deserted.
A few villagers peeked out of windows and from behind doors.
They looked scared.
Startled, the man dropped his bucket down the well and spun around.
"Why does everyone in this village seem so scared?" asked the Tang Monk.

answers.rationale: 村街空无一人，村民从窗后和门后害怕地偷看，陈也解释大家为何恐惧；他们不是凶猛或开心。

evidence.quote: He turned to Chen.
"I'm not laughing at you, sir. I'm laughing because today is the luckiest day of your life."
"You've probably never heard of me," said Wukong.
"But I am Sun Wukong, the Monkey King. I once defeated the Jade Emperor's entire army. And tomorrow I will save your son's life."
"Bring your son out here. I need to look at him."

answers.rationale: 悟空告诉陈明天会救他儿子的命，并让陈带孩子来制定计划；他没有提出毁村或寻找玉帝。

evidence.quote: Suddenly the boy changed into Wukong.
The monkey returned to Chen's home and told everyone what had happened.
"Because of you, I still have my son," said Chen. "Thank you."
They looked at Bajie.
The pig was tucked cozily under three blankets.
"Wake up, thief!"
Wujing frowned. "You stole our—ah-choo!"
"The river is frozen solid!" he said.

answers.rationale: 八戒盖着三床毯子，悟空称他为贼，悟净也指责他偷毯子，并非悟净偷八戒的；悟空确实救下男孩，河也明确冻得结实，所以 A 是不正确项。

evidence.quote: "Where's the Tang Monk?" cried Wukong.
Below the ice the Tang Monk struggled as the demon carried him deep underwater.
The demon laughed.
"You all fell for my trick! I froze the river and waited for you to cross it. Once you were above me, I cracked the ice open. As soon as your friends leave, I will eat you and live forever!"
They arrived at a palace.
The demon went inside and locked the monk in a stone box.
He was holding a large hammer.

answers.rationale: 妖怪在冰下扛走唐僧并把他锁进石箱，所以 A 成立；妖怪亲口承认是自己冻河，悟空没有冻河；大锤由妖怪持有，不是八戒。

evidence.quote: After a few minutes, Bajie pretended to be scared.
He swam upward, and Wujing soon followed.
"Cowards!" called the demon, swimming after them toward the surface.
The demon jumped out of the water and onto the ice.
Wukong was waiting for him.

answers.rationale: 八戒假装害怕向上游，悟净跟随，引诱妖怪追到水面并跳上冰面；目的地不是宫殿内或门后。

evidence.quote: "This basket has magical powers," said Guanyin.
"I will catch the demon with it. Let's go."
After a moment she pulled the basket out of the water.
A small goldfish was flopping around in it.
The villagers held a feast for the travelers that evening.
The next morning the travelers woke to the sound of chopping.
Several men were chopping down trees.

answers.rationale: 观音用篮子捉住妖怪，村民当晚也为旅行者设宴；次日砍树的是村民造船，不是悟空，因此 A 是不正确项。

evidence.quote: Wukong landed on Mount Potalaka.
A young man was meditating in the garden.
"Don't you recognize me?" said the man.
Wukong stared for a moment and then gasped.
"You're Red Boy! You look like a kind spirit now."
"Yes," said Red Boy.
"I'm not an evil demon anymore. And I have you to thank for that. You brought Guanyin to me. She has taught me all about Buddhism, and now I'm very happy."

answers.rationale: 悟空在普陀山花园认出已成为善良佛门弟子的红孩儿；妖怪在河中，陈的儿子也不在普陀山。

evidence.quote: The bodhisattva used a rope to lower the basket into the river.
She recited a spell and then waited.
After a moment she pulled the basket out of the water.
Wukong looked in the basket.
A small goldfish was flopping around in it.
"This is my goldfish," said Guanyin.

"It usually lives in my lotus pond. The pond is near my garden, where I teach my students. After years of listening to my lessons, the fish became a spirit. It escaped to Earth a few days ago. I had been wondering where it was."

answers.rationale: 观音从河中提起篮子，里面是一条小金鱼，并说明那是自己莲花池的鱼精；篮中不是石头或男孩。

evidence.quote: A large shell rose from the water.
"It's a giant turtle!" said Bajie.
The turtle bowed its head toward Wukong.
"That demon had taken over my house and river. Thank you for getting rid of him."
"I have been a good Buddhist for over a thousand years," said the turtle.
"But sadly I'm still just a turtle. Can you ask Buddha when I will be reborn as a human?"

answers.rationale: 巨龟向悟空低头并感谢众人赶走占据其家园的妖怪，所以 A 成立；它没有去寺院，且自称已做了一千多年佛教徒，并非刚皈依。

evidence.quote: The turtle then looked at the villagers.
"You don't need to make a boat. I can take the travelers across the river."
"You're traveling to the Western Paradise to get scriptures from Buddha. I knew you would cross my river eventually. Climb onto my shell."
After a little more hesitation, the travelers stepped onto the turtle's shell.
The turtle began to paddle.

answers.rationale: 巨龟让村民不必造船，主动提出把旅行者送过河并让大家爬上龟壳；它既不造船，也没有把房子送给妖怪。

evidence.quote: The turtle glanced back at the Tang Monk.
"Excuse me, but can you do me a favor?"
"Of course," said the monk.
"What do you need me to do?"
"I have been a good Buddhist for over a thousand years," said the turtle.
"But sadly I'm still just a turtle. Can you ask Buddha when I will be reborn as a human?"
The Tang Monk nodded.
"I will ask him."

answers.rationale: 巨龟请唐僧替自己问佛祖何时能转生为人；它不需要询问西天位置，也没有询问妖怪为何众多。

evidence.quote: "Look!" said the Tang Monk, pointing.
Higher up the mountain was a large monastery.
Wukong looked at the monastery.
A dark mist hung over it.
The monkey shook his head.
"That's a bad place. We're not going there."
"And I see a dark mist hanging over that monastery. A demon could be in there."
"No," said Wukong sharply. "Stay here. I will find food for us."
He looked at the monk and warned him again, "Do not go to that monastery!"

answers.rationale: 悟空看到寺院上方黑雾，明确两次禁止唐僧去那座寺院；他没有禁止询问佛祖问题，也没有禁止乘龟壳——众人此前已经安全乘过。
